title: Register Engram test-launcher runs with the TermAl host so test-runs waits and host credit cover them
outcome: An Engram gate or focused run started under TermAl appears in TermAl's test-runs index, so a session can wait on it with termal_resume_after_test_runs and the host can record its check, without an agent reading test output
acceptance: When scripts/test-launcher.mjs runs under a TermAl host, it registers each run (full or focused, detached or foreground) through TermAl's supported test-run registration, so the run is indexed in the session's project
termal_resume_after_test_runs can wait on an Engram launcher run and resumes the session with bounded terminal metadata (run id, result, counts, fingerprint check), demonstrated on a real run
Outside TermAl, or when registration is unavailable, the launcher behaves exactly as today (its --notify completion route and saved results are unchanged), with a test covering that fallback
No model operator, stdout/stderr streaming or polling is introduced

completion.summary: Register launcher runs with the TermAl host before execution, demonstrate real native waits, preserve fallback/notify behavior and bounded registration without polling or model operators. Landed and installed dcbff8c7102efe1500b0a70d08f4ee9740a829a4 with full exact-tree gate, clean release, all-six readiness and fresh independent acceptance PASS.
